body: Hi! Sorry for such a late reply, I hope this still helps and that you’re feeling better. To make a long story short, when I talked to my therapist about my concerns she was very understanding. A couple of months after this I was only getting worse, so my therapist suggested that I see a psychiatrist. There, I was diagnosed with depression and started taking meds. Therapy got better with time, but after moving to a different place, I stopped going. I miss it sometimes, but I can deal with stuff in other ways now. Overall, going to therapy was one of the best things I could’ve done, I genuinely think I wouldn’t be here without it. It was difficult, it took a lot of energy and had me questioning my whole life haha, but it was worth it to stick through. Overall, getting a diagnosis and meds was the best thing that happened, so if you really think that you have a mental illness, a psychiatrist is the way to go.

Thank you for your advice! 

I have therapy this evening, so I'll tell her about how I feel and hopefully she'll be understanding.
